name: GitVersion
help: GitVersion is a tool to help you achieve Semantic Versioning on your project.

properties.name: TargetPath
properties.help: The directory containing .git. If not defined current directory is used. (Must be first argument).

properties.name: Version
properties.help: Displays the version of GitVersion.

properties.name: Diagnostics
properties.help: Runs GitVersion with additional diagnostic information. Also needs <c>--log-file</c> (requires git.exe to be installed).

properties.name: Output
properties.help: Determines the output to the console. Can be <c>json</c>, <c>file</c>, <c>buildserver</c>, or <c>dotenv</c>. The default is <c>json</c>.

properties.name: OutputFile
properties.help: Path to the output file. Used together with <c>--output file</c>.

properties.name: ShowVariable
properties.help: Used together with <c>--output json</c>. Prints one variable. For example, <c>--output json --show-variable SemVer</c> prints <c>1.2.3+beta.4</c>.

properties.name: Format
properties.help: Used together with <c>--output json</c>. Prints a format string that contains version variables. For example, <c>--format {Major}.{Minor}</c> prints <c>1.2</c>.

properties.name: LogFile
properties.help: Path to the log file. Use <c>console</c> to write the log to stderr.

properties.name: Config
properties.help: Path to the config file. The default is <c>GitVersion.yml</c>, <c>GitVersion.yaml</c>, <c>.GitVersion.yml</c>, or <c>.GitVersion.yaml</c>.

properties.name: ShowConfig
properties.help: Prints the effective GitVersion config in YAML format.

properties.name: ConfigurationOverride
properties.help: Overrides GitVersion config values inline. For example, <c>--override-config workflow=GitHubFlow/v1</c>.

properties.name: NoCache
properties.help: Bypasses the cache. The result is not written to the cache.

properties.name: NoNormalize
properties.help: Disables the normalize step on a build server.

properties.name: AllowShallow
properties.help: Allows GitVersion to run on a shallow clone. The clone must still contain the history needed to calculate the version.

properties.name: UpdateAssemblyInfo
properties.help: Recursively searches for <c>AssemblyInfo.cs</c> files in the git repo and updates them.

properties.name: UpdateAssemblyInfoFileNames
properties.help: Names of AssemblyInfo files to update.

properties.name: EnsureAssemblyInfo
properties.help: Creates a missing assembly info file named by <c>--update-assembly-info</c>. The file gets AssemblyFileVersion, AssemblyVersion, and AssemblyInformationalVersion.

properties.name: UpdateProjectFiles
properties.help: Project files (<c>.csproj</c>, <c>.vbproj</c>, <c>.fsproj</c>, <c>.sqlproj</c>) to update. Only SDK-style projects are supported.

properties.name: UpdateWixVersionFile
properties.help: Writes the GitVersion variables to <c>GitVersion_WixVersion.wxi</c>.

properties.name: Url
properties.help: Url to the remote git repository.

properties.name: Branch
properties.help: Branch to version. This is used on its own for a local branch, or together with <c>--url</c> for a remote repository.

properties.name: Username
properties.help: Username when authentication is required.

properties.name: Password
properties.help: Password when authentication is required.

properties.name: Commit
properties.help: The commit id to check. If not specified, the latest commit on the specified branch is used.

properties.name: DynamicRepositoryLocation
properties.help: Directory for dynamic repositories. The default is the temp directory.

properties.name: NoFetch
properties.help: Disables <c>git fetch</c> during version calculation. GitVersion may then calculate a different version than expected.

properties.name: Executable
properties.help: GitVersion 7 removed this switch. Removed in v11.
properties.deprecationMessage: GitVersion 7 removed this switch. Removed in v11.

properties.name: ExecutableArguments

properties.deprecationMessage: GitVersion 7 removed this switch. Removed in v11.

properties.name: MSBuildProject
properties.help: GitVersion 7 removed this switch. Removed in v11.
properties.deprecationMessage: GitVersion 7 removed this switch. Removed in v11.

properties.name: MSBuildProjectArguments
properties.help: GitVersion 7 removed this switch. Removed in v11.
properties.deprecationMessage: GitVersion 7 removed this switch. Removed in v11.

properties.name: TelemetryOptOut
properties.help: Disables optional sampled usage telemetry.

properties.name: Verbosity
properties.help: Amount of information to display (<c>Quiet</c>, <c>Minimal</c>, <c>Normal</c>, <c>Verbose</c>, <c>Diagnostic</c>). The default is <c>Normal</c>.
